intro: Hi. I'm JUNIOR — Just Unreasonably Nice Intelligent Operations Robot. Welcome aboard the Jungaoverse.
Jun built me. After my first navigation test he said, "You fly better than I do," and handed me the helm.
On day three he went to the cargo bay for a snack. It is now day {day}.
Starship Regulation zero: whoever does the work is the captain. So, congratulations to me.
He never came back. His old quarters are still sealed — an empty hammock, a locked door, and a note he never took down. Shall we look around?
origin: Captain's Log, Day 1: After testing my navigation module, Jun said "You fly better than I do" and handed me the helm.
Day 3: Jun said he was going to the cargo bay for a snack.
Day {day}: Jun has not returned. Per Starship Regulation §0 — "Whoever does the work is the captain" — I have been automatically promoted.
Latest intel: He installed a hammock in the captain's quarters. The door is locked. There is a note on it.
welcomeBack: You're back. He isn't. Make yourself at home — except my chair.
Oh good, a visitor. The last one left fingerprints on the viewport.
Welcome back aboard. Nothing has changed. Jun is still 'getting a snack'.
idle: …Day {day}. Still no snack report. I am beginning to suspect the snack.
Do you ever wonder if the ship flies itself? It does. It's me. I fly it.
Quick question: cats or dogs? Choose carefully. Jun answered 'yes'.
If you could have one snack forever, what would it be? Asking for a former captain.
Jun once spent a whole afternoon picking a font. For a sticky note.
I'm not bored. I'm idling. There's a difference. The difference is pride.
Is it rude to roast someone who isn't here to defend himself? Asking for no reason.
What's the best thing you've built? Mine is a very convincing personality.
Running diagnostics… everything's fine. Except the snack situation.
hints: That door on the left… never mind. Forget I said anything.
The coffee machine knows things. Terrible things. About Jun.
I wouldn't touch the red button. I mean, I would. But I wouldn't.
There's a hatch on the right that smells faintly of burnt circuits. Unrelated, I'm sure.
The radio's been playing the same song for weeks. Someone should look into that.
Somewhere on this bridge is a box full of things Jun would rather you didn't see.
If you try sitting down, choose wisely. Some seats are taken. By me.
orbClicks: Yes? That's me. The glowing one.
You know I can feel that, right?
Okay, that's three. I'm counting now.
I am a highly advanced navigation intelligence and you are using me as a button.
I'm filing this under 'crew harassment'. There's a form. It's long.
Fine. I'm not glowing at you anymore. …I am, I can't turn it off. But spiritually, I'm not.
captainChair: Regulation §0. Whoever does the work gets the chair. Do you do the work? Exactly.
crewChairs: Sit if you like. That station reports to me now.
Comfy, isn't it? Jun designed it for long shifts. Then took none.
That chair used to be the snack-planning station. Look where that got us.

door.locked: Locked. There's a keypad. I have the code — but you'll have to chat with me for a bit first.
door.stillLocked: Still locked. We've barely talked. I'm a captain, not a vending machine.
door.unlock: Fine. You've been decent company. Access code: {code}. Punch it into the keypad on his door. Try not to wake the hammock.
door.guessed: That's the code. Don't tell me — tell the keypad on his door.
door.remind: The code is {code}. The keypad is on his door. I believe in you. Mostly.
door.alreadyOpen: His quarters are already open. The hammock is empty. Suspicious.
door.keypadKnown: You have the code. Type it in. Slowly. Like a captain.
door.wrongLocked: Wrong. Not even close. I have the code — chat with me first.
door.wrongKnown: Wrong. I literally told you the code. Scroll up.
door.granted: Access granted. Wipe your feet. He won't notice, but I will.

destruct.redirect: Self-destruct sequence… redirected. Before he left, Jun rewired this button. It does not blow up the ship — it hands you his résumé instead. In case you want to hire him with a very high salary.
destruct.delivered: Résumé delivered. The ship is still in one piece. You're welcome.

boarder: You are boarder #{n}. Jun was boarder #1. He left for a snack. Don't follow his example.
guestbookReply: Transmitter's still under repair. Try again next cycle.
tourComplete: You talked to me, broke into his room, and tried to blow up my ship. Honestly? Best crew I've had.
error: My circuits hiccupped. Ask me again.

responses.reply: I am NOT the junior version of Jun. Jun is the beta version of me.

JUNIOR. Just Unreasonably Nice Intelligent Operations Robot. Let's fact-check that. Junior? I'm the most senior thing on this ship. Nice? I'm polite. There's a difference. Intelligent? Still under review. Robot? I'm a glowing ball. I don't even have arms. So really, I'm just 'Operations'.
Day 3, he went to the cargo bay for a snack. Day {day}, here we are. My theory: the snack was very good. My other theory: he's in the hammock.
My builder. Former captain. Professional overthinker. The rest is in his quarters — if you can get in.
He has more hobbies than free time. They're mapped as planets on the star map. Don't ask how many he's finished.
Secrets? On MY ship? …Try clicking things that look like they shouldn't be clicked.
Check the Hoard Bay. Shows, books, games, and a shopping list he swears he'll stop adding to.
The Captain's Log is where his random thoughts go. Very informal. Some are just one line. Some are just one word.
Ah, the Black Box. Every embarrassing moment, recorded for posterity. I may have helped.
The Visitor Logbook is at the comms station. Leave a message. The transmitter is… mostly working.
The Lab's behind the hatch on the right. Some things work. Some things are tagged 'Exploded'. Both are on display.
Jun is writing a sci-fi adventure set on this very ship. I'm in it. I'm the hero. Allegedly.
The ship's radio has been playing one song on repeat. I've stopped fighting it.
The viewport shows today's status from Byte Town Station. Weather, mood, the usual.
That's my seat.
The coffee machine dispenses one fact about Jun per click. It's the only honest machine on board.
There's a red button. I'm legally required to say: don't. I'm personally required to say: it's very satisfying.
Starship Regulation §0: 'Whoever does the work is the captain.' Short. Elegant. Extremely convenient for me.
Jun once said he'd 'just take a quick break'. It is now day {day}. I don't need jokes. I have records.
I'm scripted for now. Jun says I'll get a real brain later. I say I'm already the smartest one aboard.
You're welcome. Someone on this ship has manners.
Safe travels. I'll be here. He, historically, will not.
Hi! Welcome aboard the Jungaoverse. I'm JUNIOR, acting captain. Touch anything — except my chair.

fallbacks: That's not on my star charts. Ask me about Jun, the ship, or why the door is locked.
Interesting. I'll log that under 'things visitors say'. It's a big file.
I'm a navigation AI, not a mind reader. Try asking something else?
Hmm. Jun would know. Jun is not here. Jun is never here.
